hold: predict_history retains its previous value when no update event occurs.
predict_history is unspecified when no update event occurs.
On idle cycles (areset=0, predict_valid=0, train_mispredicted=0), history_next = (history << 1) & 0xFFFFFFFF, shifting in 0 instead of holding.
async_reset: Reset clears only on the rising edge of areset; after that, areset high does not block normal posedge updates.
